description:
QTL and marker-trait associations read from the tables of open-access wheat papers (PubMed Central full text,
mostly 2015 onwards, complementing WheatQTLdb and GWAS Atlas). Search by trait words (matched in the table's trait
column and caption), chromosome ('2A'), RefSeq v1.0 region ('6A:230-250Mb') or gene (window_kb around it). Each row
gives the trait, QTL name, marker, chromosome, the position as reported (assembly as stated in the paper, often
RefSeq v1.0 or v2.1), the RefSeq v1.0 position of the marker where it could be placed, cM, LOD, p, PVE, the table
caption and the paper with its licence. Tables were parsed automatically: check a surprising row in the paper.
name: paper_qtl
